items.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
items.body: By downloading, installing, or using Entre Dos ("the App"), you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.

items.title: 2. Description of Service
items.body: Entre Dos is a card-based game designed for couples. The App provides digital card decks with activities, questions, and prompts intended to strengthen relationships.

items.title: 3. Eligibility

items.title: 1. Information We Collect
items.body: We collect the information you provide when creating your account, such as your name, email address, and anniversary date. We also collect usage data to improve your experience in the app.

items.title: 2. Use of Information
items.body: We use your information to: operate and maintain the app, personalize your experience, send you game-related notifications, and improve our services.

items.title: 3. Storage and Security
items.body: Your information is stored securely on protected servers. We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access.

items.title: 4. Sharing Information
items.body: We do not sell, trade, or transfer your personal information to third parties. We only share data with service providers necessary for the operation of the app.

items.title: 5. Your Rights
items.body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time. You can request a copy of your data or ask for its deletion by contacting us directly.

items.title: 6. Cookies and Similar Technologies
items.body: We use tracking technologies to improve the app's functionality and analyze usage patterns. You can manage these preferences from your device settings.

items.title: 7. Minors
items.body: Entre Dos is not intended for minors under 18 years of age. We do not intentionally collect information from minors. If we discover that we have collected data from a minor, we will delete it immediately.

items.title: 9. Contact

items.question: What is Entre Dos?
items.answer: Entre Dos is a card-based game designed for couples. Each card contains activities, questions, or prompts to help you connect with your partner.

items.question: How do I play a card?
items.answer: Open a card from your deck and swipe to confirm. Once played, the card will be marked as completed and added to your history.

items.question: Can I replay a card?
items.answer: Currently, each card can only be played once. New cards are added to your deck regularly, so there's always something fresh to explore.

items.question: How do I change my language?
items.answer: Go to Settings > Language and select your preferred language. The app supports English and Spanish.

items.question: How do notifications work?
items.answer: You can enable or disable notifications in Settings > Notifications. When enabled, you'll receive reminders about new cards and game activity.

items.question: How do I delete my account?
items.answer: Go to Settings > Delete Account. Your account will be deleted in 7 days and you can cancel the request by signing in before that date.
